introduction: This spec defines the bootstrapping layer for carry-patch mode in the `nightshift` daemon: Pydantic config models (`HubConfig`, `CarryPatchConfig`), CLI flags with 3-tier resolution, startup CWD validation against the hub workspace, default config generation, and workspace variable initialization that disables hub-side auto-rebuild.

glossary.AF_HUB_TOKEN: Environment variable read by `resolve_hub_pat()` to supply the hub PAT.
glossary.AF_HUB_URL: Environment variable used as the second tier in hub URL resolution.
glossary.AF_WORKSPACE: Environment variable used as the second tier in workspace slug resolution.
glossary.AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH: Hub workspace variable set to `"false"` by nightshift on startup so the hub does not trigger rebuilds automatically after push.
glossary.AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC: Hub workspace variable set to `"false"` by nightshift on startup so the hub does not trigger rebuilds automatically after sync.
glossary.AgentFoxConfig: Top-level Pydantic config model for the agentfox system, defined in `packages/agentfox/agentfox/core/config.py`.
glossary.CarryPatchConfig: Pydantic model added to AgentFoxConfig holding all carry-patch tunable parameters such as `workspace`, `check_interval`, `auto_resolve`, `rebuild_timeout`, `rebuild_poll_interval`, and `max_resolve_retries`.
glossary.Clamped: Internal annotated-type utility in `agentfox.core.config` that silently clamps out-of-range integer values to the declared bounds instead of raising a ValidationError.
glossary.DaemonRunner: Existing synchronous daemon loop class in `nightshift.app` whose `run()` method is invoked after startup validation completes.
glossary.HubAuthError: Exception from `afhub` raised on HTTP 401 Unauthorized responses from the hub API.
glossary.HubClient: Async HTTP client from the `afhub` package (Spec 01_afhub_client) used to communicate with the hub REST API.
glossary.HubConfig: Pydantic model added to AgentFoxConfig holding the hub API base URL (`endpoint_url`).
glossary.HubConnectionError: Exception from `afhub` raised when a network-level connection to the hub fails.
glossary.HubError: Base exception class for all hub API errors in the `afhub` package.
glossary.HubForbiddenError: Exception from `afhub` raised on HTTP 403 scope-missing responses from the hub API.
glossary.HubNotFoundError: Exception from `afhub` raised on HTTP 404 responses from the hub API.
glossary.PAT: Personal Access Token used to authenticate requests to the hub API.
glossary.Workspace: Pydantic model returned by `HubClient.get_workspace()` containing fields `workspace_mode`, `clone_status`, `git_url`, and `integration_branch`.
glossary.WorkspaceConfig: Existing Pydantic model in `agentfox.core.config` with a `merge_strategy` field typed as `Literal['direct', 'branch', 'pr']`.
glossary.auto_resolve: Field on `CarryPatchConfig` controlling whether nightshift automatically attempts to resolve detected conflicts.
glossary.carry-patch mode: Operational mode of nightshift where it monitors a hub workspace for conflicts and drives a fix pipeline; activated when both `--workspace` and `--token` resolve to non-empty values.
glossary.check_interval: Field on `CarryPatchConfig` controlling how often (in seconds) nightshift polls for conflicts; minimum 60, default 300.
glossary.clone_status: Field on the `Workspace` model indicating the hub-side clone state; must equal `"ready"` before nightshift proceeds.
glossary.config_gen.py: Module at `packages/agentfox/agentfox/core/config_gen.py` that holds the global default AgentFoxConfig comment-annotated TOML template.
glossary.endpoint_url: Field on `HubConfig` storing the hub API base URL.
glossary.get_workspace: Method on `HubClient` that fetches a `Workspace` model by slug from the hub API.
glossary.git_url: Field on the `Workspace` model containing the expected remote origin URL for the local git checkout.
glossary.integration_branch: Field on the `Workspace` model (nullable string) written into the generated `.nightshift/config.toml` under `[workspace]`.
glossary.max_resolve_retries: Field on `CarryPatchConfig` capping the number of automatic conflict-resolve retries; range 0-10, default 2.
glossary.merge_strategy: Field on `WorkspaceConfig` written explicitly in the generated `.nightshift/config.toml`; defaults to `'direct'`.
glossary.nightshift: The CLI daemon entry point located in `packages/nightshift/nightshift/app.py` that orchestrates conflict monitoring and fix pipelines.
glossary.rebuild_poll_interval: Field on `CarryPatchConfig` specifying the polling interval in seconds when waiting for a rebuild; minimum 2, default 5.
glossary.rebuild_timeout: Field on `CarryPatchConfig` specifying the maximum seconds to wait for a hub rebuild to complete.
glossary.resolve_hub_pat: Function imported from `afhub.auth` that reads the hub PAT from the `AF_HUB_TOKEN` environment variable.
glossary.resolve_hub_url: Function imported from `afhub.auth` that resolves the hub API base URL using a 3-tier chain: CLI flag > `AF_HUB_URL` env var > config file value.
glossary.set_variable: Method on `HubClient` that upserts a workspace variable via PATCH-then-POST; used to set `AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC` and `AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH`.
glossary.workspace slug: Short identifier string for a hub workspace, supplied via `--workspace` CLI flag, `AF_WORKSPACE` env var, or `carry_patch.workspace` config field.
glossary.workspace_mode: Field on the `Workspace` model indicating the operational mode; must equal `"carry_patch"` for this spec.
glossary.build_streams: Function in `agentfox.nightshift.streams` that constructs the set of work streams (fix-pipeline, pr-feedback, carry-patch) registered with the daemon; receives a `HubClient` instance from `main()` when carry-patch is active.
glossary.CarryPatchMonitor: Class in `agentfox.nightshift.carry_patch_monitor` that monitors the hub workspace for conflicting patches and coordinates the resolution workflow; does not own the `HubClient` lifecycle.
glossary.FixPipeline: Existing class in `agentfox.nightshift.fix_pipeline` that implements the coder-reviewer-reviewer loop for resolving GitHub issues; receives a `HubClient` in carry-patch mode.
glossary.startup_helper: The async function in `packages/nightshift/nightshift/_carry_patch_startup.py` that performs CWD validation, workspace variable initialization, and returns the `HubClient` instance to `main()`.

user_story.goal: add HubConfig and CarryPatchConfig Pydantic models to AgentFoxConfig with safe defaults
user_story.benefit: so that existing config files without these sections continue to load cleanly and carry-patch is disabled by default

acceptance_criteria.action: populate `hub` with a `HubConfig` instance whose `endpoint_url` defaults to an empty string
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: HubConfig(endpoint_url='') is accessible as config.hub
acceptance_criteria.trigger: AgentFoxConfig is instantiated without a `[hub]` section in the TOML file

acceptance_criteria.action: populate `carry_patch` with a `CarryPatchConfig` instance using all documented defaults: enabled=False, workspace='', check_interval=300, auto_resolve=True, rebuild_timeout=600, rebuild_poll_interval=5, max_resolve_retries=2
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: CarryPatchConfig with all default values is accessible as config.carry_patch
acceptance_criteria.trigger: AgentFoxConfig is instantiated without a `[carry_patch]` section in the TOML file

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: config.carry_patch.rebuild_poll_interval == 2
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a TOML config supplies a `rebuild_poll_interval` value below 2

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: config.carry_patch.max_resolve_retries == 10
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a TOML config supplies a `max_resolve_retries` value above 10

acceptance_criteria.action: ignore the unknown keys without raising a ValidationError, consistent with `extra='ignore'` on both models

edge_cases.action: accept the value as-is without clamping

user_story.benefit: so that nightshift can be configured flexibly across different deployment environments without hardcoding secrets

acceptance_criteria.trigger: the operator invokes `nightshift` with `--hub-url`, `--workspace`, and `--token` flags all set to non-empty values

acceptance_criteria.action: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` explaining the PAT is required and exit

acceptance_criteria.action: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` explaining the hub URL is required and exit
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: process exits with code 1; error message is written to stderr
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: hub URL is empty after checking CLI flag, AF_HUB_URL, and config.hub.endpoint_url while carry-patch mode is otherwise active

user_story.role: operator running nightshift in carry-patch mode
user_story.goal: have nightshift verify the current working directory matches the expected hub workspace before starting the daemon
user_story.benefit: so that conflicts are never monitored against the wrong local checkout

acceptance_criteria.action: construct a single `HubClient` instance as `HubClient(endpoint_url=resolved_hub_url, pat=resolved_pat)` and call `hub_client.get_workspace(slug)` to retrieve the `Workspace` model
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Workspace model is returned; the same HubClient instance is reused for all subsequent API calls in this startup sequence
acceptance_criteria.trigger: carry-patch mode is active and the async startup helper calls `get_workspace(slug)`

acceptance_criteria.action: emit a diagnostic error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating an invalid PAT or insufficient permissions and exit
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: process exits with code 1; error message is written to stderr
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: `get_workspace` raises `HubAuthError` (401) during the workspace lookup call

acceptance_criteria.action: emit a diagnostic error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating the PAT has insufficient scope or permissions and exit
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: process exits with code 1; error message is written to stderr
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: `get_workspace` raises `HubForbiddenError` (403) during the workspace lookup call

acceptance_criteria.action: emit a diagnostic error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating the workspace slug was not found and exit
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: process exits with code 1; error message is written to stderr
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: `get_workspace` raises `HubNotFoundError` during the workspace lookup call

acceptance_criteria.action: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating the workspace is not in carry-patch mode and exit
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: process exits with code 1; error message is written to stderr

acceptance_criteria.action: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating the workspace clone is not ready (showing the actual `clone_status` value) and exit

acceptance_criteria.action: invoke `subprocess.run(['git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin'], stdout=PIPE, stderr=PIPE, timeout=10, cwd=Path.cwd())` using the blocking form; decode stdout and stderr with `encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'` before any comparison or error message use

requirements.title: Default config generation on first start

user_story.role: operator running nightshift for the first time in a workspace
user_story.goal: have nightshift automatically generate a `.nightshift/config.toml` with all tunable parameters documented
user_story.benefit: so that the operator can review and adjust settings without needing to know the config schema

acceptance_criteria.action: create the `.nightshift/` directory if absent, write the config to a temporary file `config.toml.tmp`, then atomically rename it to `config.toml`; the file contains `[hub]`, `[carry_patch]`, and `[workspace]` sections with all tunable fields written explicitly
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: `.nightshift/config.toml` exists with UTF-8 encoded TOML content matching the documented template; `.nightshift/config.toml.tmp` does not exist after successful write
acceptance_criteria.trigger: CWD validation passes and `.nightshift/config.toml` does not exist in the CWD

acceptance_criteria.action: skip config generation entirely without reading or modifying the existing file
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: existing `.nightshift/config.toml` is unchanged
acceptance_criteria.trigger: CWD validation passes and `.nightshift/config.toml` already exists in the CWD

acceptance_criteria.action: write `integration_branch = ""` in the `[workspace]` section
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: generated TOML contains `integration_branch = ""`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the config file is being generated and `workspace.integration_branch` is `None`

acceptance_criteria.action: emit `logging.warning(...)` describing the failure and continue startup without exiting
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: nightshift continues to run; a warning log entry is written; if the failure occurred after writing the temp file but before the rename, `config.toml.tmp` may remain on disk, but `config.toml` is unmodified
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: any OS-level exception is raised during directory creation, temp file write, or atomic rename when writing the config file

acceptance_criteria.action: never write the PAT to the generated `.nightshift/config.toml` file under any circumstances
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: generated config file contains no PAT or token value

acceptance_criteria.action: not reload the newly-written config into the live `AgentFoxConfig`; all resolved values remain as-is in memory for the current session
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the in-memory `AgentFoxConfig` instance is unchanged after config file generation

edge_cases.action: proceed normally with the atomic write without attempting to create the directory again
edge_cases.trigger: `.nightshift/` directory already exists but `config.toml` is absent

edge_cases.action: emit `logging.warning(...)` and continue; the temp file `config.toml.tmp` may remain on disk but nightshift does not attempt cleanup
edge_cases.return_contract: nightshift continues to run; warning log is written
edge_cases.error_condition: the OS rename operation raises an exception when atomically renaming config.toml.tmp to config.toml after the temp file was written

edge_cases.action: write the actual branch name as the value of `integration_branch` in the `[workspace]` section
edge_cases.trigger: the generated config is written and `workspace.integration_branch` is a non-empty string

edge_cases.action: include `[hub]` and `[carry_patch]` sections with comment annotations in the global default AgentFoxConfig TOML template in `config_gen.py`
edge_cases.return_contract: the global template contains `[hub]` and `[carry_patch]` sections
edge_cases.trigger: config_gen.py global TOML template is rendered

user_story.role: operator running nightshift in carry-patch mode
user_story.goal: have nightshift automatically disable hub-side auto-rebuild on startup
user_story.benefit: so that nightshift controls rebuild timing and avoids race conditions with hub-triggered rebuilds

acceptance_criteria.action: call `await hub_client.set_variable(slug, 'AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC', 'false')` and then `await hub_client.set_variable(slug, 'AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH', 'false')` using the same `HubClient` instance constructed in REQ-3
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: `AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC` and `AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH` are set to `'false'` on the hub workspace
acceptance_criteria.trigger: CWD validation passes and the async startup helper proceeds to variable initialization

acceptance_criteria.action: emit `logging.warning(...)` describing the failure and continue startup without exiting
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: nightshift continues to run; a warning log entry is written; the daemon loop starts normally
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: any exception including HubForbiddenError, HubConnectionError, or any other HubError subclass is raised by either set_variable call

acceptance_criteria.action: return the HubClient instance to main(); main() receives the client, passes it to daemon components (build_streams, FixPipeline, CarryPatchMonitor), invokes DaemonRunner.run(), and closes the client in a finally block via asyncio.run(hub_client.aclose())
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a HubClient instance; the daemon loop starts after the async startup_helper returns; the client is closed by main() on daemon exit; CarryPatchMonitor must not call aclose()
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the async startup helper completes successfully

edge_cases.action: emit `logging.warning(...)` and still attempt the second `set_variable` call for `AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH`
edge_cases.return_contract: both calls are attempted independently; nightshift continues regardless of either failure
edge_cases.error_condition: the first set_variable call for AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC raises an exception

edge_cases.action: the idempotent PATCH-then-POST upsert in `set_variable` completes without error
edge_cases.return_contract: no error is raised; the call is a no-op from the operator's perspective
edge_cases.trigger: `set_variable` is called when the variables are already set to `'false'` on the hub

edge_cases.action: execute the full CWD validation and variable initialization sequence within a single event loop created by `asyncio.run()`
edge_cases.return_contract: the event loop is created and destroyed by `asyncio.run()`; no RuntimeError from a pre-existing running loop occurs in production
edge_cases.trigger: the async startup helper is invoked via `asyncio.run()` from synchronous `main()`

correctness_properties.title: CarryPatchConfig clamping is monotone
correctness_properties.for_any: integer value v supplied for `check_interval`, `rebuild_poll_interval`, `rebuild_timeout`, or `max_resolve_retries`
correctness_properties.invariant: the stored value equals max(min_bound, min(v, max_bound)) where bounds are those declared by `Clamped`

correctness_properties.title: Carry-patch mode requires both workspace slug and PAT
correctness_properties.for_any: any combination of CLI flags, environment variables, and config file values
correctness_properties.invariant: carry-patch mode is active if and only if both the resolved workspace slug and the resolved PAT are non-empty strings

correctness_properties.title: Hub URL resolution is strictly ordered
correctness_properties.for_any: any combination of `--hub-url` flag, `AF_HUB_URL` env var, and `config.hub.endpoint_url`
correctness_properties.invariant: the resolved hub URL is the first non-empty value in the order: CLI flag > `AF_HUB_URL` > `config.hub.endpoint_url`

correctness_properties.title: CWD validation is all-or-nothing
correctness_properties.for_any: any startup invocation with carry-patch mode active
correctness_properties.invariant: the daemon loop starts if and only if all CWD validation steps pass; any single step failure causes process exit with code 1. The failure modes that each trigger sys.exit(1) are: HubAuthError from get_workspace, HubForbiddenError from get_workspace, HubNotFoundError from get_workspace, workspace_mode != 'carry_patch', clone_status != 'ready', git binary not found (FileNotFoundError), git non-zero exit code, git origin URL mismatch

correctness_properties.title: Config file is never overwritten
correctness_properties.for_any: any startup invocation where `.nightshift/config.toml` already exists
correctness_properties.invariant: the content of `.nightshift/config.toml` is identical before and after nightshift startup

correctness_properties.title: PAT is never persisted to disk
correctness_properties.invariant: the generated config file contains no PAT or token value

correctness_properties.title: Variable initialization failures are non-fatal
correctness_properties.for_any: any exception raised by `set_variable` during startup
correctness_properties.invariant: nightshift emits a warning log and proceeds to start the daemon loop; it never exits due to a `set_variable` failure

correctness_properties.title: Single HubClient instance is reused across startup
correctness_properties.for_any: any startup invocation with carry-patch mode active
correctness_properties.invariant: exactly one `HubClient` instance is constructed during the async startup helper; it is reused for `get_workspace` and both `set_variable` calls

execution_paths.title: Happy path: first-time carry-patch startup with config generation

steps.action: invokes `nightshift --hub-url https://hub.example.com --workspace my-slug --token myPAT`
resolves hub URL via `resolve_hub_url`, workspace slug via inline expression, PAT from `--token` flag; detects carry-patch mode is active
invokes `asyncio.run(startup_helper(...))` with resolved values
constructs `HubClient(endpoint_url=resolved_hub_url, pat=resolved_pat)`
calls `hub_client.get_workspace('my-slug')` and receives a `Workspace` model with `workspace_mode='carry_patch'`, `clone_status='ready'`, and a matching `git_url`
invokes `subprocess.run(['git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin'], ...)` and receives the local origin URL
strips trailing whitespace from the local origin URL and confirms it matches `workspace.git_url`
emits `logging.info(...)` confirming CWD validation succeeded
detects `.nightshift/config.toml` does not exist; creates `.nightshift/` directory, writes `config.toml.tmp`, atomically renames to `config.toml`
calls `await hub_client.set_variable('my-slug', 'AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC', 'false')` and `await hub_client.set_variable('my-slug', 'AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH', 'false')`
invokes `DaemonRunner.run()` to start the synchronous daemon loop

execution_paths.title: CWD mismatch: operator is in the wrong directory

steps.action: invokes `nightshift --workspace my-slug --token myPAT` from a directory whose git origin does not match the hub workspace `git_url`
resolves carry-patch mode as active; invokes `asyncio.run(startup_helper(...))`
calls `hub_client.get_workspace('my-slug')` and receives a `Workspace` model with `clone_status='ready'`
invokes `subprocess.run(['git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin'], ...)` and receives a URL that does not match `workspace.git_url`
emits an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` showing both URLs and instructing the operator to `cd` into the correct directory; calls `sys.exit(1)`
process exits with code 1

execution_paths.title: No carry-patch flags: nightshift runs in normal mode

steps.action: invokes `nightshift` with no `--workspace` or `--token` flags and no corresponding environment variables or config values
resolves workspace slug and PAT as empty; determines carry-patch mode is not active
skips the async startup helper entirely; invokes `DaemonRunner.run()` directly
starts the fix-pipeline daemon loop without any hub API calls

execution_paths.title: Missing PAT with workspace slug: error exit

steps.action: invokes `nightshift --workspace my-slug` with no `--token` flag and `AF_HUB_TOKEN` unset
resolves workspace slug as `'my-slug'`; attempts to resolve PAT from `--token` flag (absent) then `resolve_hub_pat()` (returns empty)
detects workspace slug is non-empty but PAT is empty; emits error via `click.echo(..., err=True)` explaining PAT is required; calls `sys.exit(1)`
process exits with code 1

execution_paths.title: set_variable failure is non-fatal: daemon starts anyway

steps.action: invokes `nightshift --workspace my-slug --token myPAT` in a valid workspace directory
completes CWD validation successfully and proceeds to variable initialization
calls `await hub_client.set_variable('my-slug', 'AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC', 'false')`; call raises `HubForbiddenError`
catches the exception, emits `logging.warning(...)`, and continues to the second `set_variable` call
calls `await hub_client.set_variable('my-slug', 'AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH', 'false')`; call also raises `HubConnectionError`
catches the exception, emits `logging.warning(...)`, and returns normally
invokes `DaemonRunner.run()` to start the daemon loop

error_handling.behavior: emit diagnostic error via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating invalid PAT or insufficient permissions; call `sys.exit(1)`
emit diagnostic error via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating the PAT has insufficient scope or permissions; call `sys.exit(1)`
emit diagnostic error via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating workspace slug not found; call `sys.exit(1)`
emit error via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating workspace is not in carry-patch mode; call `sys.exit(1)`
emit error via `click.echo(..., err=True)` showing the actual `clone_status` value and indicating the workspace clone is not ready; call `sys.exit(1)`

error_handling.condition: `subprocess.run` raises `FileNotFoundError` when invoking `git remote get-url origin`
error_handling.behavior: emit the exact message 'git is not installed or not in PATH; nightshift requires git' via `click.echo(..., err=True)`; call `sys.exit(1)`

error_handling.condition: `subprocess.run` raises `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` when invoking `git remote get-url origin`
error_handling.behavior: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating the git command timed out; call `sys.exit(1)`

error_handling.condition: `subprocess.run` returns a non-zero exit code from `git remote get-url origin`
error_handling.behavior: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` including the captured stderr output; call `sys.exit(1)`

error_handling.condition: local origin URL does not match `workspace.git_url` after stripping trailing whitespace
error_handling.behavior: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` showing both URLs and instructing the operator to `cd` into the correct directory; call `sys.exit(1)`

error_handling.condition: PAT resolves to empty when `--workspace` is non-empty
error_handling.behavior: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` explaining the PAT is required; call `sys.exit(1)`

error_handling.condition: hub URL resolves to empty when carry-patch mode is otherwise active
error_handling.behavior: emit an error message via `click.echo(..., err=True)` explaining the hub URL is required; call `sys.exit(1)`

error_handling.condition: writing `.nightshift/config.toml` fails for any OS-level reason
error_handling.behavior: emit `logging.warning(...)` describing the failure and continue startup without exiting

error_handling.condition: `set_variable` raises any exception during workspace variable initialization
error_handling.behavior: emit `logging.warning(...)` describing the failure and continue startup; attempt the second `set_variable` call independently
emit diagnostic error via `click.echo(..., err=True)` indicating a connection failure; call `sys.exit(1)`

symbols.name: HubClient
symbols.notes: Async HTTP client for the hub REST API. A single instance is constructed once in the async startup helper and reused for all API calls.

symbols.name: HubClient.get_workspace
symbols.signature: async def get_workspace(self, slug: str) -> Workspace
symbols.notes: Returns a Workspace model. Raises HubAuthError (401/403) or HubNotFoundError (404) on failure.

symbols.name: HubClient.set_variable
symbols.signature: async def set_variable(self, slug: str, key: str, value: str) -> None
symbols.notes: Upserts a workspace variable using PATCH-then-POST. Any exception is treated as non-fatal in this spec.

symbols.name: resolve_hub_url
symbols.signature: def resolve_hub_url(*, hub_url_flag: str | None = None, config_url: str = '', env_var: str = 'AF_HUB_URL') -> str | None
symbols.notes: Encapsulates 3-tier resolution: CLI flag > AF_HUB_URL env var > config_url. Returns the first non-empty value, or None if all tiers are empty. All parameters are keyword-only. The caller must check for None before using the result.

symbols.name: resolve_hub_pat
symbols.signature: def resolve_hub_pat(*, token_flag: str | None = None, env_var: str = 'AF_HUB_TOKEN') -> str | None
symbols.notes: Reads AF_HUB_TOKEN from the environment. Returns the PAT string or None if not set. All parameters are keyword-only. The caller handles the CLI --token flag tier via token_flag.

symbols.name: HubError
symbols.notes: Base exception class for all hub API errors.
